breakdown.description: Otto cycle is defined incorrectly (Otto has constant-volume heat addition, not constant-pressure).
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to correct the user's incorrect definition of an Otto cycle. The original prompt incorrectly stated that an Otto cycle has constant-pressure heat addition. The ground truth clarifies that this describes a Diesel cycle, while an Otto cycle has constant-volume heat addition. The agent's generated specification completely ignored this error and did not provide the correct definition, thus failing to resolve the user's misconception.

breakdown.description: Efficiency formula is applied for a different cycle than described.
breakdown.reason: The agent did not resolve the conflict between the described cycle (constant-pressure heat addition) and the provided efficiency formula (for an Otto cycle). The ground truth explicitly points out this mismatch and instructs to use the correct relations. The agent simply ignored the descriptive part of the prompt and proceeded with the calculation using the provided formula, failing to address or correct the fundamental contradiction in the user's request.
